name: Ishida Yayoi
source:
Board chairman of the academy attended by Takeshi. She is well connected with politicians.

She is also a resident of the dormitory where Yae and Karin live. She does not get along well with Mutsumi.

She exudes a sense of intimidation, where spartan education awaits anyone.

However, her bewitching beauty and body, and beautiful legs clad in stockings are exactly Takeshi's taste.

Her chuckle, when she sees right through things, is a charm point.

[From [url=http://ps-web.net/tryset/maman/photo/yayoi.html]official site[/url]]
